title: Evaluation is invariant under deduplication
statement: Let $k$ be a conjunction or disjunction gate, let $l$ be a finite list of natural-number input indices, and let $vals$ be a finite list of Boolean values. The gate with kind $k$ and input list obtained from $l$ by removing repeated entries has the same evaluation on $vals$ as the gate with input list $l$.
hypotheses_covered: The gate kind $k$ is not negation (so it is conjunction or disjunction)
$l$ is a list of natural-number input indices
$vals$ is a list of Boolean values
